A '''ballistic ejection seat''' was a type of [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]] manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]]. [[Armor/Legends|Armored]] and crash-worthy, the ballistic ejection seat was fitted in [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]]. In the two-seat [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]], either the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] could trigger the seats, launching both at the same time.<ref name="SWTSE" />
